title.narrative: A Sub-Sahara Africa Multi-Country Climate Resilience Programme for Food Security

description.narrative: Providing climate protection and targeted resilience building to over 2.7 million people across 12 countries in the Sub-Sahara region under the 3 pillars of i) scaling up disaster risk financing, ii) transforming the food systems through home-grown school meals and clean cooking, and iii) supporting smallholder farmers to build production and livelihood resilience. Gender equality and women’s empowerment is a significant objective and there will be conducted a gender analysis. The twelve countries are Madagascar, Malawi, Mozambique, Tanzania, Zimbabwe, Burkina Faso, Chad, Mali, Niger, South Sudan, Somalia and Mauritania.
